name: core
description: Working-style rules for Claude Code, loaded into each session by a SessionStart hook, plus guard hooks that start in dry-run.

delete_guard_dry_run.title: Delete guard: dry-run
delete_guard_dry_run.description: On: log the deletes it would block and allow them. Off: block them.

protected_paths.title: Delete guard: protected paths
protected_paths.description: Absolute paths (or ~/...) the guard protects, one per line or separated by colons. Empty: the guard does nothing.

worktree_sweep_dry_run.title: Worktree sweep: dry-run
worktree_sweep_dry_run.description: On: log the merged, clean worktrees it would remove. Off: remove them and their local branches.

worktree_sweep_roots.title: Worktree sweep: root folders
worktree_sweep_roots.description: Absolute folders; only worktrees under them are swept. One per line or separated by colons. Empty: the sweep does nothing.

reaper_dry_run.title: Stale-agent reaper: dry-run
reaper_dry_run.description: On: log the processes it would stop. Off: stop them.

reaper_max_age_hours.title: Stale-agent reaper: age in hours
reaper_max_age_hours.description: Processes that started longer ago than this are stopped. Counts time since start, not idleness.

reaper_match.title: Stale-agent reaper: command match
reaper_match.description: Text a process command line must contain to be stopped, one per line or separated by colons. Empty: the reaper does nothing.
